messages.author: 4edee7e2edd7472b
messages.subject: annotate.WithGenicParts error
parts:
Hello,

 I have used this command before without any problem. But, now I am getting an error. The only difference is that I am trying the new version of the genome assembly. If anyone can shed some light on how to solve this problem, I would really appreciate it. Here are my commands.

Thank you,
Neel

>library(methylKit)

>library(BSgenome.Drerio.UCSC.danRer10) # I generated this genome using forgeBSgenomeDataPkg()

>file.list=list("~/Desktop/GRCv10_RRBS_Brain/zr1121_9.sam","~/Desktop/GRCv10_RRBS_Brain/zr1121_10.sam","~/Desktop/GRCv10_RRBS_Brain/zr1121_11.sam","~/Desktop/GRCv10_RRBS_Brain/zr1121_12.sam","~/Desktop/GRCv10_RRBS_Brain/zr1121_13.sam","~/Desktop/GRCv10_RRBS_Brain/zr1121_14.sam","~/Desktop/GRCv10_RRBS_Brain/zr1121_15.sam","~/Desktop/GRCv10_RRBS_Brain/zr1121_16.sam")

>myobj=read.bismark(file.list,sample.id=list("DMSO1","DMSO2","DMSO3","DMSO4","PCB1","PCB2","PCB3","PCB4"),assembly="BSgenome.Drerio.UCSC.danRer10",treatment=c(0,0,0,0,1,1,1,1),save.context="CpG",read.context="CpG",save.folder=getwd())

>meth=unite(myobj,destrand=FALSE)

>head(meth)

>getCorrelation(meth,plot=T)

>hc=clusterSamples(meth, dist="correlation", method="ward", plot=TRUE)

>PCASamples(meth, screeplot=TRUE)

>PCASamples(meth)

>tiles <- tileMethylCounts(myobj, win.size = 1000, step.size = 1000)

>head(tiles[[1]])

>meth.min <- unite(tiles, min.per.group = 1L)

>myDiff <- calculateDiffMeth(meth.min)

>myDiff25p.hyper <- get.methylDiff(myDiff,difference = 25, qvalue = 0.01,type="hyper")

>myDiff25p.hypo <- get.methylDiff(myDiff,difference = 25, qvalue = 0.01,type="hypo")

>gene.obj <-read.transcript.features("refGene.bed.txt", up.flank=1000, down.flank=1000, unique.prom=TRUE) # This bed file was obtained following the guidelines in the methylKit vignette.

>annotate.WithGenicParts(myDiff25p.hyper, gene.obj)

messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] annotate.WithGenicParts error
parts:
it could be something to do with naming conventions of the chromosomes, make sure they are identical in methylation basecalls and annotation. If you have further questions, please send a reproducible example

Best
Altuna

Thank you for writing a really nice software package and for responding to all the queries. I really appreciate it.

Best wishes,
Neel
